long_desc.zh: LangGraph 是 LangChain 团队推出的 Agent 编排框架，支持有状态图、循环、人机协作、持久记忆。适合构建复杂多步骤 Agent 系统，支持流式输出和并行执行。
long_desc.en: LangGraph is an agent orchestration framework from the LangChain team, supporting stateful graphs, cycles, human-in-the-loop, and persistent memory. Ideal for building complex multi-step agent systems with streaming and parallel execution.

zh: 有状态图支持循环和分支
en: Stateful graphs with cycles and branches

zh: 需要 Python 编程能力
调试复杂 Agent 系统较难
en: Debugging complex agent systems is challenging

short_desc.zh: 让 AI 控制浏览器执行任务的 Agent 框架
short_desc.en: AI agent framework that controls browsers to execute tasks

long_desc.zh: Browser Use 是一个开源 Python 框架，让 LLM 通过视觉理解和 DOM 解析来控制浏览器。支持多标签页、文件上传下载、表单填写等复杂操作。适合自动化网页任务和数据采集。
long_desc.en: Browser Use is an open-source Python framework that lets LLMs control browsers through visual understanding and DOM parsing. Supports multi-tab operations, file uploads/downloads, form filling, and more. Ideal for automating web tasks and data collection.

zh: 视觉理解 + DOM 双模式
速度受浏览器渲染限制

short_desc.zh: 微软出品的多 Agent 对话框架

long_desc.zh: AutoGen 是微软研究院开发的多 Agent 框架，通过 Agent 间对话协作完成复杂任务。支持自定义 Agent 角色、工具调用、代码执行和群聊模式。适合研究和原型开发。
long_desc.en: AutoGen is a multi-agent framework from Microsoft Research that accomplishes complex tasks through agent-to-agent conversations. Supports custom agent roles, tool calling, code execution, and group chat modes. Ideal for research and prototyping.

zh: 灵活的 Agent 角色定义
群聊模式支持多 Agent 讨论
en: Group chat mode for multi-agent discussion

zh: 文档不如 LangChain 完善

short_desc.zh: 数据驱动的 LLM 应用和 Agent 框架
short_desc.en: Data framework for LLM applications and agents

long_desc.zh: LlamaIndex 是连接私有数据与 LLM 的领先框架，提供数据连接、索引、检索和 Agent 工具。支持 100+ 数据源集成，RAG 管线开箱即用，适合构建知识增强的 AI 应用。
long_desc.en: LlamaIndex is a leading framework for connecting private data with LLMs, providing data connectors, indexing, retrieval, and agent tools. Supports 100+ data source integrations with out-of-the-box RAG pipelines. Ideal for building knowledge-enhanced AI applications.

pricing.zh: 开源免费 + LlamaCloud 云服务

zh: 与 LangChain 功能有重叠

short_desc.zh: Anthropic 的计算机使用 Agent API

long_desc.zh: Claude Computer Use 是 Anthropic 推出的 Agent API，让 Claude 能查看屏幕截图、移动鼠标、点击和打字来操作电脑。适合构建桌面自动化 Agent，Anthropic 提供安全的沙箱环境。
long_desc.en: Claude Computer Use is an agent API from Anthropic that enables Claude to view screenshots, move the mouse, click, and type to operate a computer. Suitable for building desktop automation agents, with Anthropic providing a secure sandbox environment.

pricing.zh: 按 API 调用付费（/M input, /M output）

zh: 需要 Anthropic API 访问权限
